report.summary: Console now defaults to INFO (was VERBOSE for all of esp-idf) with the maximum at VERBOSE so runtime levels actually work, MIPI/DSI/ADC/SPI-mem tags held at WARN, and settings no longer take the dashboard off screen.

components.name: app_logic
components.notes: log_level.cpp rewritten: on boot it sets the panel's OWN tags (13 product + 6 framework tags) to DEBUG, holds MSPI/ADC/esp_lcd/lcd/dsi/mipi/esp_ldo at WARN regardless of the selection, and sets '*' from the stored choice (INFO when none). heating_ui.cpp gained heating_ui_settings_enter() — the settings overlay drawn over the existing cards, never a second or cleared screen. heating_web.cpp routes both GET and POST /settings through it before parsing the form.

components.name: sdkconfig
components.notes: CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL_INFO=y replaces LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL_VERBOSE, and CONFIG_LOG_MAXIMUM_LEVEL_VERBOSE=y is now explicit — the previous 'leave the maximum at its default' left it equal to the default, so every runtime esp_log_level_set() above INFO was a silent no-op. A #error in log_level.cpp now refuses that combination.

diagnosis: Noise: sdkconfig.defaults set CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL_VERBOSE, so every esp-idf component logged VERBOSE; the build also left CONFIG_LOG_MAXIMUM_EQUALS_DEFAULT, which pinned the maximum to the default and made all runtime level changes no-ops (that is why 'log * INFO' appeared to do nothing).

Blank display after settings: nothing in the firmware switched LVGL screens. What a visitor sees on an RGB panel is the panel briefly losing its scanout signal — and the firmware was writing 7 KB of printk-level VERBOSE log to UART0 at 115200 (63 ms of busy-waiting per burst) on the same core that feeds the frame buffer, exactly while the page was being rendered. The console volume is fixed above; the panel side now also never leaves the cards: any path into the settings just draws an address overlay over them.
notes: app_webui.cpp kept its original behaviour after a trial edit was reverted: the settings page still streams through httpd_resp_sendstr_chunk with the block's request bridge, so nothing in the web framework changed this round.
The settings overlay is transient by design (tap anywhere closes it) and drawn on the LVGL task; it is never in the path of the dashboard's clock, banner or dim timer.
verification: Generated sdkconfig confirmed INFO default / VERBOSE maximum.
